evidence: Changes .github/workflows/ci.yml and multiple ci/ scripts to replace FreeBSD cross-compilation with a native VM CI job.
rationale: Catches FreeBSD platform regressions in per-PR CI before they reach master. The author and reviewers cite recent master regressions (e.g., #36078 and #36145) that required reactive fixes because tests were not executed on BSD targets, making this a durable reliability improvement for supported platform testing.
